title: Battle of the Ages (orchestral, instrumental)
style: Instrumental, no sung lyrics, epic cinematic orchestral battle music, full symphony orchestra: driving staccato string ostinato, pounding taiko and orchestral war drums, heroic brass fanfares with French horns, trumpets and trombones, soaring string melody, wordless epic choir swells, timpani rolls, cymbal crashes, building from a tense low-string intro to a massive brass-and-choir climax, trailer style, Hans Zimmer and Two Steps From Hell inspired, D minor, 4/4, 140 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro - instrumental, tense low strings and distant war drums, building]

[Build - instrumental, staccato string ostinato, French horns enter, timpani rolls]

[Battle theme - instrumental, full orchestra, heroic brass melody, pounding percussion, epic choir swells]

[Interlude - instrumental, brooding strings and solo horn, drums pull back]

[Climax - instrumental, massive brass and choir, soaring strings, full orchestra at full power, cymbal crashes]

[Outro - instrumental, final brass hit, timpani roll, long decay]
